content.text:
On 2026-09-23, the most Acme Manufacturing can get off the NS-500 Industrial Controller under its contract is **15% of list price**.

- **Where it comes from:** Acme's Master Supply Agreement, signed 2025-03-22, says: *"Customer is eligible for discounts of up to 15% on the NS-500 Industrial Controller, as set out in the pricing exception attached as Schedule B."* The knowledge base records this 15% limit as running from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31, so 2026-09-23 falls inside it. (Acme is listed under the name "Acme Mfg. Holdings.")
- **The older limit doesn't apply:** A 2023 pricing exception allowed up to 10% off list for orders placed from 2023-04-01 to 2025-03-31. It ended before the 15% limit began.
- **15% isn't automatic:** The same agreement says the contract terms don't change Northstar's internal approval authority. Each discount still has to be approved under Northstar's internal policies, so any discount up to 15% needs the usual sign-off.
